Gratheon · beehive scale · phase 3

Beehive scale

A wooden hive stand with one load cell, a battery-powered ESP32 pod flush in its side and a temperature + humidity probe that goes in through the entrance. No loose cables, nothing sticking out. An Entrance Observer bolted to its front powers it; it also fits the Robotic Beehive.
